source_reviews.author: Sailko
source_reviews.visual: Three coordinated Latin altar cards in heavily silvered ornate frames on museum dark-plinth exhibition with reflections. All three visible; genuine Catholic object form, but not appreciably more representative for an ordinary 1962 parish Mass than existing ornate hero.

source_reviews.author: Bojan Jankuloski (Bjankuloski06)
source_reviews.visual: Wall-mounted monumental Crucifix of Christ above altar, not a freestanding altar crucifix with base. The file's title 'altar crucifix' does not establish a single freestanding physical object as required by AL06.

source_reviews.author: Wilfredor
source_reviews.visual: Matched clear-glass Catholic Mass cruets with cross-topped gold stoppers and handles on a single tray; water uncoloured in left vessel, golden-coloured wine in right vessel. Very recognisable vessel type for the Traditional Latin Mass, but image is a generic Mass photograph and not certified from a 1962-rubrics celebration. Crops preserve each vessel without fabricating its form.

subobject_crops.image_quality_note: Complete water bottle but ornate gold candle/linen objects remain soft-focus in background; 763px width.
Complete wine bottle but decorated gold object remains soft-focus behind; 683px width.

source_reviews.caveats: One photograph split into two truthful single-object crops; source photo count remains ONE. Two crops are not two independently photographed objects. Context of source is modern Catholic Mass, not necessarily 1962; classification is physically appropriate to TLM, not evidence of a particular historical liturgy.

licence_policy: CC0 source allows original crop redistribution without copyright attribution mandate. Retain Wilfredor and Wikimedia Commons source provenance nonetheless.
